Page 145 Cont.
May 21 Mrs. Frances Wilkowski - 53 - cancer of uteris in St. Joseph Hosp- ital. Drs fear too late to operate.
Page 146
May 21 Mrs. Martha Rooms - 62 - very peculiar heart-trouble - coughing and hemoraging practically every day for a year .. been receiving Holy Communion only seldomly - Husband and son - her promise more frequent Com 'n and
Dennis M. Miller - 42 very threatening tumor in arm was fractured a year ago. Mother a convert ... Father once a dayly Communicant. Has been going of late only twice a month. Father promises more frequent Communion and Enrolls him.
Joan Schelb - 19 - poor health for three yrs. now in Ford Hospital feared having colitis .... and stomach ulcers.
Martha Clark - 5 - liukemia - give 5 to 1- days to live (n Ford's) However they are experimenting - Father ofthe child a Christian but not certain as to what denomination he was raised in.
Mrs. Eleanor Soper - 56 - congregationalist - sugar-diabetis.
Page 147 May 24 Mrs. Frances Paddock - 54 - arthritis wants to continue able to take care of her two youngest till settled in life.
25 Joseph Schulte - 70 - gangrenous diabetis - seven years ago lost three toes instead of his leg ... Drs say "only a matter of short time. Enrolled in Ser. Masses ...
Girard Bedour - 19 - of Godrich Ont. - recently started to have fits - like Epylepsi
Grace Denomme - 25 - peculiar ailment that Drs. are baffled.
Bernadette Mousseau - 54 - kidney stone
Gustav Katoll - 59 - lutheran-very threatening Heart condition.
26
Thanks - Marg. Ryan - now Mrs. Fuller - 33 - in 1937 was having ter- rible spells ... Enrolled perpetually in Ser. Masses when Drs. said nothing could be done ... never had another spell - Now has husband and two beautiful children.
